text:
Alex: Heads-up — I pushed a first-pass Grafana dashboard for the new runtime metrics (link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/runtime-new). Can folks look at the panels and advise on alert rules / pager routing?

Sam: Thanks Alex. Saw it briefly. Which metrics are you planning to alert on? latency, error rate, or infra (GPU)?

Alex: Primary ones I wired:
- runtime.latency.p95_ms
- runtime.error_rate.5m
- runtime.kv_cache.hit_ratio
- gpu_utilization.percent
- queue_length.requests
I left a note on the dashboard about proposed thresholds but want cross-team alignment.

Priya: Linking the oncall perspective: we want clear severity tiers and avoid noisy P0s. My proposal:
- P0: error_rate > 5% for 5m OR p95 latency > 2s with traffic > 100r/s (immediate page)
- P1: sustained SLO burn rate > 2 for 10m (notify primary rotation)
- P2: resource saturation (GPU > 90% for 15m) -> email + next-day runbook review
Thoughts?

Ren: Quick note on instrumentation: runtime.error_rate is currently computed at SDK layer (per request). For aggregated monitors use the sum(errors)/sum(requests) over rolling window. Also recommend renaming the metric to inference.error_rate to match other services.

Sam: Agree with Ren about names. If we rename we'll need a short migration alias for existing dashboards/monitors. Also: the p95 latency alert should be conditional on traffic to avoid flapping when traffic is near zero. I like the traffic > 100r/s gate.

Jordan: From SRE/SLO side: we should explicitly tie alerts to SLO burn signals. Proposed Datadog-style monitor for burn:
```
query: "sum:service.slo.burn_rate{service:runtime}.rollup(sum, 60) > 2"
notify: "pagerduty://runtime-oncall?severity=warning"
```
If burn_rate > 5 for 5m escalate to critical.

Priya: Pager routing callout: P0 -> primary oncall, P1 -> rotation with escalation policy (primary -> secondary -> eng-leads), P2 -> slack channel + email. Also want an automated suppression window for deploys: if deploy-bot posts a deploy tag within last 10m, suppress non-critical firing for 5m.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: service=runtime, sha=abc123, env=prod, duration=3m  :rocket:

Marta: From product / console team: we need dashboard panels that map directly into runbooks so oncall can click 'open runbook' and see steps. Can we add a small link/button panel that points to the runbook for each alert?

Alex: Good idea. I'll add an annotation panel with runbook links. Also adding the deploy-bot suppression is doable — Sam, can you confirm Datadog supports monitor silencing via tags from CI?

Sam: Yes, Datadog has monitor silencing and a webhook-based suppression. We can build a lightweight lambda that receives the deploy-bot webhook and calls the Datadog silence API scoped to the runtime service tag. I'll draft an RFC for that.

Ren: One more internal-api debate: do we expose "inference.queue_length" as per-model or per-cluster? For alerting we prefer per-cluster but dashboards should allow drilling to model-level.

Priya: Per-cluster alerting makes routing simpler. Model-level panels are nice for debugging but shouldn't drive pages unless cluster-level thresholds are OK.

Jordan: Operationally, add a dedupe rule: collapse identical alerts that share the same group key (service:runtime + region). That avoids multiple pages for the same root cause.

Alex: OK action items I captured:
- Rename metric suggestion (Ren) + provide alias plan (Sam)
- Update dashboard with runbook links (Alex)
- Implement deploy-bot -> Datadog silence webhook (Sam)
- Create Datadog monitors: P0/P1/P2 with thresholds above (Jordan + Priya)
- Add dedupe/grouping by service+region (Jordan)
- Confirm pager routing escalation policies in PD (Priya + Marta)

Priya: I'll open the PD policy ticket and ping legal for escalation contacts.

Sam: I'll sketch the silence lambda this afternoon and post the code snippet.

Ren: I'll add a per-cluster metric export and flag model-level dims in the telemetry export.

Alex: Sweet — can folks react with :thumbsup: when done or leave a quick comment if you disagree? Planning to move monitors to prod by EOD tomorrow if no objections.

Marta: :thumbsup:

Priya: :thumbsup: 

Jordan: :thumbsup: 

Sam: will post lambda link shortly.

pd-bot: pagerduty: new escalation policy created for service=runtime (policy id: ep-6729)

Alex: Thanks all. Closing thread after PRs land.
